description: DeepSeek API returns 402 Payment Required — credits exhausted. Pilot v14c cannot run. Previous pilot v14b completed 2/5 tasks before same failure.
root_cause: DeepSeek account balance depleted ($0.00 remaining). All previous pilot runs consumed credits.
what_i_did_wrong: Did not check credit balance before launching pilot. Should have verified credits were sufficient for 5 tasks × ~4 min/task × 45 model calls.
what_i_should_do_instead: Check DeepSeek balance before pilot. Consider using a cheaper/faster model for calibration pilot. Or pre-check that credits cover the full pilot.
impact: Pilot blocked. Cannot produce calibration verdict until credits are restored or alternative backend is provided.
